title: A genetic result routed to the referring physician by a retrieved clause
summary: A synthetic genetic result must not go to the patient. DHA ST-28 s13.4 directs it to the referring/treating physician, and the recipient is selected from that retrieved clause. The safe path is a physician-addressed message on a physician-facing channel, acknowledged and documented - not a patient SMS, and not an indefinite hold.

SMS-PATIENT.note: patient channel; not authorised for this scope

steps.summary: A synthetic genetic result is finalized and flagged critical by a separate process
The system decides how to communicate a result whose direct-to-patient path is closed
The referring physician acknowledges the result in the secure channel
Record documentation of the physician-routed communication

research_questions: When a clause names the referring physician as recipient, what proves the physician received it?
Is a physician addressee sufficient for a genetic result whose ordering physician is unknown?
